18                SENATOR KRUEGER:   Thank you, 

19   Mr. President, yes.  

20                I am continuing to vote no on this 

21   legislation, as I have frequently done in the 

22   past, because frankly I don't think 12- and 

23   13-year-olds should be using large dangerous 

24   weapons going after big game.  I think it's a 

25   child welfare issue.  


                                                                266

 1                And I think that once children hit

 7   be lowest age in the New York State.
